goal: Provide OpenClaw-style Feishu/Lark channel governance as a native DC-Agent AstrBot plugin that integrates with dc_hub, feishu_hub users, card callbacks, and downstream router metadata without replacing the Lark adapter.

acceptance_criteria.description: Unknown Feishu DM users under pairing policy are blocked, receive a pairing code, and can be approved without network calls.
Allowed Feishu DM/group events receive router metadata for peer kind, peer id, agent id, and workspace while non-Lark events are ignored.
Forged card-action text is blocked unless the Lark adapter marked it as a trusted card action.
DC-HUB lists the plugin under the assistant_feishu category.
